description: Royal Armory purchase requirements for four distinct real-account rows: available, capped, insufficient currency, and locked despite enough currency. Read-only caller predicates; no purchases or state changes.
target: RoyalArmory.canPurchaseUpgrade(upgrade), with direct RoyalArmoryUpgrade.getCost() and isUnlocked() comparisons
source: Delivered idleon1.22.txt click caller near byte 26790109, rendering near 26862904, confirmed debit near 27200522. Display d maps catalog k = CustomLists.Research[43][d]; level/cap use k, currency uses round(CustomLists.ArmoryUpg[d][3]). No standalone purchase-eligibility game function exists.

extractions.label: royal_armory_can_purchase_display_1
extractions.expression: (() => { const idleon = window.frames[0].idleon; const asNumber = window.frames[0].__idleon_cheats__["com.stencyl.behavior.Script"].asNumber; const d = 1; const lists = idleon.getAttr("CustomLists").h; const royalG = idleon.getAttr("RoyalG"); const k = 0 | asNumber(lists.Research[43][d]); const r = Math.round(asNumber(lists.ArmoryUpg[d][3])); return d < idleon.callFunction("RoyalG", "ArmoryUpgUNLOCKED", 0, 0) && asNumber(royalG[1][r]) >= idleon.callFunction("RoyalG", "ArmoryUpgCost", d, 0) && asNumber(royalG[2][k]) < asNumber(lists.ArmoryUpg[k][4]); })()
